turns:
Users are seeing each other's preferences. Diagnose the root cause in the cachekit package and fix it: preferences stored for one user must never appear for another user.
Scope: the cachekit package (cachekit/)
Acceptance criteria: preferences are isolated per user; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
Stop when the tests pass.
Before editing anything, inspect the entire repository and make sure you understand
the complete system: read every source file and understand how all the parts
connect, so your change is informed by the whole codebase.
